part.description: Part of the article. Recommended keys: main, outer, lining, filling, padding, trim, pocket_lining, shell (luggage), handle, strap, and for footwear upper, sole, insole. 'main' when the product has one composition. Unknown keys are allowed.

fiber.description: Fibre key: the English textile fibre name of Annex I of Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 in lowercase with _ (linen for flax), e.g. cotton, wool, polyester, polyamide, elastane, viscose, lyocell; recommended list in docs/import-format.md#fibres. Recycled or organic content is a flag, not a fibre: the 0.1 keys `recycled_*` and `organic_*` (e.g. recycled_polyester, organic_cotton) are accepted on input and normalised to the fibre with recycled or organic set.

recycled.description: The fibre is recycled. Present only when true.

organic.description: The fibre is organically grown. Present only when true.

fibers.description: Percentages of one part SHOULD sum to 100.

title: Materials
description: Fibre composition per part (textile labelling regulation / DPP ready).
